# Ronz EV

> Ronz EV is an electric vehicle dealer in Kasaragod district, Kerala, India, selling low-speed electric scooters that can be ridden without a driving licence or registration (top speed up to 25 km/h, motor up to 250 W).

## Showrooms
- Chengala Showroom: Vadhi Thoybha, Chengala, Kasaragod, Kerala 671541 (12.510194, 75.042944)
- Melparamba Showroom: Bridgestone – The Tyre Shop, KSTP Road, Kattakal–Kainoth Road, Melparamba, Kasaragod, Kerala 671317 (12.461928, 75.011492)
- Areas served: Chengala, Melparamba, Kasaragod, Cherkala, Vidyanagar, Chemnad, Kalanad, Bovikkanam, Badiadka, Uduma, Bekal, Kumbla, Kanhangad
- Email: info@ronzev.com

## Key facts
- No driving licence, RTO registration or number plate needed for the low-speed models
- Range: over 120 km (lithium-ion), over 80 km (lead-acid) per charge
- Charging: 3–4 hours (lithium-ion), 4–5 hours (lead-acid) from a home socket
- 18-month battery warranty, anti-theft alarm with remote, cruise control, LED headlamp
- Suitable for students, seniors and short daily trips

## Models
Terius, Terius+, Loen Legend, Eco Rider, GX250, Greenova, Greenova 100, Verno. Full specifications: https://ronzev.com/products/{model}, e.g. https://ronzev.com/products/terius-plus

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need a driving licence to ride a Ronz EV scooter?
  A: No. Ronz EV low-speed models have a top speed of up to 25 km/h and a motor rated up to 250 W, which are exempt from a driving licence under Indian motor vehicle rules.
- Q: Does a no licence electric scooter need registration or a number plate?
  A: No. Low-speed electric scooters within the 25 km/h and 250 W limits do not need RTO registration or a number plate.
- Q: Where can I buy a no licence electric scooter in Kasaragod?
  A: At Ronz EV: Vadhi Thoybha, Chengala 671541, or Bridgestone – The Tyre Shop, KSTP Road, Melparamba 671317.
- Q: Who can ride a no licence scooter?
  A: Students, seniors, homemakers and anyone making short daily trips who does not hold a licence.
- Q: How long does charging take?
  A: About 3–4 hours for lithium-ion and 4–5 hours for lead-acid, from a regular home socket.
